name: Saibara Kamui
source:
"Well then, how about sitting next to me? I'll make it worth your while."

A 17-year-old high schooler in Class 3-B.

The school's most popular playboy who's always surrounded by girls. Though he may appear shallow at first glance, he's kind and considerate to others, which has garnered him many friends.

He has the utmost respect for his grandfather who raised him.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
